messages:
Maria Chen: Kicking off the router migration window now. Target: route traffic from edge-router:v10 -> edge-router:v11. Window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Plan: 0% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with checks between steps. deploy-bot: Job queued (id=rb-2026-03-21-1769998888). :rocket:
deploy-bot: Starting phase 1 -> setting green weight to 5%. command: `routerctl weight set edge-router v11 5`
Kevin O'Neill: Monitoring p95 and errors. Thresholds: p95 > 400ms OR error-rate > 0.8% => abort and rollback. I'll call it if I see drift. ops-sre: I'll tail infra metrics.
ops-sre: Quick health check before we move beyond 5%:
```
ops-sre: curl -sS https://edge-router-internal/_health | jq .status
ops-sre: # expecting {"status":"ok"}
```
Oliver Patel: Noted. I pushed a small routing tweak earlier (sticky session TTL to 30s) — should be harmless but flagging in case we see session errors.
deploy-bot: Phase 1 complete, green=5%. Time: +3m. Observability links: https://console/redwood/obs/route/edge-router?window=5m
Kevin O'Neill: p95=210ms, errors=0.12% over last 5m. No alarms. Proceeding to 20%. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Moving to phase 2 -> setting green weight to 20%
```
deploy-bot: routerctl weight set edge-router v11 20
```
ops-sre: Watching for tail-latency spikes and DNS anomalies. Also checking region egress distribution.
Maria Chen: Reminder: if we see a progressive drift in error-rate (0.1% -> 0.4% -> 0.9%) across phases, we stop and failover back to v10. Kevin if you say rollback I will initiate the drain plan. :warning:
deploy-bot: Phase 2 complete, green=20%. Time: +12m. Metrics: p95=230ms, errors=0.18%. No rate-limited alarms.
Oliver Patel: Small uptick in 502s in eu-west1 (12 -> 18) but still within noisy baseline. ops-sre: could you check upstream timeouts?
ops-sre: Checking upstreams.. looks like a transient spike from a single backend pod in eu-west1. Restarted pod 3 of cluster-a. 502s falling back to baseline.
Kevin O'Neill: With that cleared, move to 60%. If anything worse appears we stop.
deploy-bot: Phase 3 -> setting green weight to 60%
```
deploy-bot: routerctl weight set edge-router v11 60 --grace-period=30s
```
deploy-bot: Phase 3 complete, green=60%. Time: +18m. Observability: p95=260ms, errors=0.22% (stable).
Maria Chen: Live monitoring for final shift. If no regressions in next 5m I will request final cut.
Kevin O'Neill: p95 creeping to 320ms in ap-southeast but still under 400ms. Error-rate 0.4% - acceptable. Proceed to 100%.
deploy-bot: Initiating final cut -> setting green weight to 100%
```
deploy-bot: routerctl weight set edge-router v11 100 --drain-old=120s
```
deploy-bot: Final cut complete, green=100%. Time: +25m. :tada:
Maria Chen: Confirming we are at 100% and old pool drained. Please add any post-mortem notes if you observed anomalies.
Oliver Patel: I saw a momentary bump in downstream retries during the 60->100 transition but nothing persistent. I'll capture the trace: https://console/redwood/traces/trace-abc123
Kevin O'Neill: Good job team. No rollback needed. Closing window early by 2m since all checks passed. :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: Closing thread. Will file release note and tag changelog. Thanks everyone.
